name: Dinah
summary: The daughter of Jacob and Leah. After Shechem defiled her, her brothers Simeon and Levi took revenge on his whole city.

key_moments.title: Born to Leah
key_moments.description: After bearing Jacob six sons, Leah bore a daughter and named her Dinah.

key_moments.title: Taken by Shechem
key_moments.description: Dinah went out to see the young women of the land. Shechem, son of the local prince Hamor, took her and defiled her, and her brothers were furious.

key_moments.title: Taken Out of Shechem's House
key_moments.description: Simeon and Levi took their swords, killed the men of the city, and brought Dinah out of Shechem's house. Jacob told them they had brought trouble on him.
